name: Citizenship by Marriage to a Macedonian Citizen

requirement_groups.name: Married and resident in North Macedonia

requirements.blocker_text: Law on Citizenship, Article 9: a foreigner married to a Macedonian citizen for at least 3 years, with at least 1 year of continuous residence in North Macedonia, may naturalize with exemptions from the standard residency (7 years), income/housing, and language requirements, and from the renunciation-of-prior-nationality requirement. The law's own text is gender-neutral, referring simply to a spouse of a citizen.
requirements.fix_path: Marry a Macedonian citizen, remain married for 3 years, and establish 1 year of continuous residence in North Macedonia, then apply with the standard exemptions.

requirement_groups.name: Married and resident abroad, with demonstrated ties

requirements.blocker_text: Article 9's alternative track: a foreigner married to a Macedonian citizen for at least 8 years while living abroad, who can demonstrate firm ongoing ties to North Macedonia, qualifies for the same exemptions (residency, income, language, renunciation) without ever having resided in the country.
requirements.fix_path: Remain married to a Macedonian citizen for 8 years while documenting maintained ties to North Macedonia, then apply.

evidence_required.document: Proof of continuous residence (domestic track) or documented ties to North Macedonia (abroad track)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 1 year continuous residence (domestic track only; the abroad track requires none)

sources.title: Refworld (UNHCR-affiliated) -- hosted consolidated English text of North Macedonia's Law on Citizenship (2022 consolidation), Article 9 (marriage-based naturalization, domestic and abroad tracks)
